title: Great quality! Great size! A must have for every kitchen!
text: Great quality! Great size! A must have for every kitchen!. I love Calphalon products and use them almost exclusively in my kitchen. Sure, they are expensive. But when it comes to quality and durability, Calphalon can't be beat. It is truly the old adage 'You get what you pay for' applies when shopping for your kitchen. This large stock pot is beautiful and stands up to my tough cooking (I have a tendency to stir and use items in the pots that I probably shouldn't). I have even run this through the dishwasher a few times and it comes out looking like new. This is a great size for cooking soups and pasta. Would make a great bridal shower present for the bride who has all the basics, to help expand her kitchen ware. It also would make a great 'not so new' homeowner or renter to just help make their kitchen complete (think holiday shopping). I love this Signature series!

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Signature Hard-Anodized Nonstick 8-Quart Stock Pot with Cover
features: Built to last, with a 1.5x more durable nonstick interior (vs Calphalon Classic)
Heavy-gauge, hard-anodized aluminum construction heats evenly for precision cooking and performance
Oven-safe up to 500 degrees F, so you can easily go from stovetop to the oven
Metal-utensil-safe, with a durable, PFOA-free, 3-layer nonstick interior
Recognized as BEST Overall Nonstick Cookware by Good Housekeeping
description: Calphalon Signature Hard-Anodized Nonstick Cookware delivers a 1.5x more durable nonstick interior (vs Calphalon Classic) for effortless food release, so you can cook with confidence and serve even the most delicate food with ease. Designed and engineered in the United States, this cookware features a durable, PFOA-free, 3-layer nonstick interior that is tough enough to withstand metal utensils and holds up to everyday use. Calphalon Signature nonstick pots and pans are oven-safe up to 500 degrees F, so they can go from the stovetop to the oven for heating and cooking versatility, and are dishwasher-safe for easy cleaning. Discover professional-level precision and performance with Calphalon Signature, and experience superior cookware that's built to last.
